ios.desc:
Gravitus is the ultimate workout tracker & planner for the gym. Lift without ads for free. Elevate your weight lifting with advanced routines, a thriving community and the largest exercise database in the world! Track, log, and train like a pro with Gravitus.


WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
• “Probably the best workout tracking app I’ve used. Really friendly UI and easy to monitor your progress overtime” - Dyl711
• "Love love this app. It’s helped my fitness journey so much." - Amanda itunes
• “I never write app reviews but I have to rave about Gravitus- my only regret is not getting it sooner. You get so much data and insight from your lifts, allowing you to track progressive overload and challenge yourself to continuously add weight/reps.  I feel like I’m getting so much more from my workouts, and this app is going to blow up my gains in an extraordinary way!“ - the_megalodon98


FEATURES
• Blazing Fast: We are iOS native, lift, don’t lag!
• Intuitive tracking: Autofill workouts, rest timers, and more
• No Ads: Focus on your workouts, not ads
• Build community: Follow friends, share workouts, post videos, and more
• Every exercise: 1,000+ exercises, with video demos, instructions, and more
• Dark Mode: Workout in style with our dark mode
• Privacy: Share your workouts with the community, or keep them private
• Apple Watch: Stay in the zone, workout on your wrist with our watch app
• Apple Health: Sync workouts with Apple Health


WORKOUT PROGRAMS AND TEMPLATES
• Choose one of our workout programs or create your own
• Workout programs for every skill level and goal
• Workout reminders: Get notified when it’s time to workout
• Progression: Track your progress with our progression tracker


ANALYTICS AND TOOLS
• Charts and graphs to track your progress
• Muscle engagement shows you which muscles are being worked
• Plate calculator to calculate the weight of your plates
• Exertion score to track your intensity
• Exercise progression info to track your progress
• 1RM calculator to calculate your rep maxes
• Rest timers: Quickly customize rest timers for each exercise


APPLE WATCH
• Stay in the zone, workout on your wrist with our watch app
• Workout automatically syncs between your phone and watch
• Intuitive rest timer keeps your workout on track
• Live heart rate to monitor your intensity and recovery


IOS FEATURES
• Sync workouts with Apple Health
• Dynamic island to never lose track of your workout
• Live activity on your lock screen
• Watch companion app to wo
